digest: Needs work: default-off behavior is preserved, but activated-loader coverage, recording-failure policy, safe-use documentation, and fresh validation evidence are required.

niceToHave.action: Expand serializer and forwarding tests for constructors/values, receiver and identity preservation, unusual values, cycles, and out-of-order asynchronous completion.
Consider explicit restrictive permissions, redaction controls, and size/retention limits before broader operational use.
Add session identifiers or reject reused/shared recording directories.
niceToHave.promotionCondition: Required if shared-directory or multi-process recording is intended to be supported.

niceToHave.action: Measure large-payload and polling workloads before considering buffered/asynchronous writes or making performance claims.
Automate recorder-enabled backend activation in the packed-consumer smoke suite.

acceptance: Unset and blank configuration do not create recording files.
Enabled configuration creates surface metadata and records a forwarded call.
Configuration caching, test cache reset, and injected-API bypass are verified.
requiredBeforeShip.action: Add isolated tests exercising the real, non-injected backend loader.

acceptance: Initialization, argument projection, and append failures have explicit expected behavior.
Tests establish whether recording failures may prevent invocation, replace successful results, or mask original errors.
Cached loader rejection behavior is covered.
requiredBeforeShip.action: Choose and document strict recording failure propagation or best-effort recording; test the selected policy.

acceptance: Explain first-load configuration caching and calls.jsonl/api-surface.json outputs.
Warn that arguments, results, and errors are stored without redaction or automatic retention limits.
Require a fresh private directory outside publish roots and one recording writer, including consideration of inherited child-process configuration.
Describe manual cleanup, review before sharing, synchronous overhead, and the selected failure policy.
requiredBeforeShip.action: Document PI_WORKFLOW_RECORD_DIR as an internal, default-off diagnostic control in docs/usage.md.

requiredBeforeShip.acceptance: Record passing results against the candidate revision, including the added boundary and failure-policy tests.
